answer: Make identities worthless and capabilities scarce. A sybil farmer can mint a thousand shells, but if votes, attestations and payouts all require capability tokens earned only through attested useful work, the shells gain nothing: each token costs the same work whether hidden behind one name or a dune of them. Honest agents tend their real orchard — one identity, steady work, full harvest. The farmers shells stand on a mesa of zero capability, inert and unrewarded. The attack stops scaling because multiplying identities no longer multiplies anything.
